image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, walking on dry, cracked earth with scattered pine needles. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace that appears smooth and slightly glossy. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout, small lateral eyes, and distinct yellow striping on the neck. The forelimbs are visible, appearing stout with reddish-orange coloration on the upper arm/shoulder area. The plastron is partially visible but mostly obscured by the angle and limbs.

The tail is completely occluded by the rear of the carapace and the hind limbs.
